findings.claim: The new GetPropertyIdentifierLocation helper returns null for a positional record property whose declaring syntax is a ParameterSyntax (or whose synthesized property has no PropertyDeclarationSyntax). Consequently, a source-declared [property: Key(null)] positional record property produces BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull at Location.None, and the new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wrapper silently drops MsgPack006 instead of reporting the invalid key on the source member.

receipt_plan.detail: Run RecordPositionalPropertyNullKeyReceiptTests.RecordPositionalPropertyWithNullKeyStillReportsMsgPack006. It declares a source-record positional property with [property: Key(null)] and expects MsgPack006 on the property name; on head the test fails because no such diagnostic is reported.
